1 دَغَلَ فِيهِ , aor.
دَغَلَ , (K,) inf. n. دَغْلٌ, (TA,) He entered it like as enters he who is doing a thing that induces doubt, or suspicion, or evil opinion; (K, TA;) like as the hunter enters the lurkingplace to circumvent the game: so in the T and M. (TA.) ＝
-A2- دَغَلَ لَهُمُ الشَّرَّ He sought, or desired, to do to them evil, or mischief, when they thought that he desired to do them good. (T, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
